in_marathi.name: Devlilansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods, Shining, Resplendent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devlilansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devlilansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words, ‘Deva’ meaning 'God' and ‘Lilansh’ meaning 'shining' or 'resplendent'. This name is used to represent the God of Gods, Indra, who is known for his radiant and powerful presence. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain, thunder, and lightning, and is believed to bestow prosperity, strength, and courage upon his devotees.
